maldives-centara-grand-lagoon.lead: One overwater villa, a private sandbank and a reef full of manta rays: the Maldives distilled into ten unhurried days.

reasons.t: A villa with its own lagoon
reasons.d: An overwater villa with direct lagoon access and a private sun deck, where breakfast arrives floating in your villa pool, with fruit, pastries and champagne.
A private picnic on a deserted sandbar in the middle of the ocean, with white linen and champagne and no other island in sight, plus a dolphin sunset cruise.
A guided snorkelling safari over coral gardens with manta rays, turtles and reef sharks, and a luxury spa treatment in an overwater room.

maldives-cocoon-collection.lead: A boutique Maldives escape that gets beyond the resort: seaplane arrival, local island visits and a reef with a marine guide.

reasons.d: A seaplane transfer over the atoll, with scattered islands, turquoise lagoons and overwater villas below before you land.
Island hopping to authentic local Maldivian islands, with fishing villages, traditional markets and fresh seafood.
A luxury yacht sunset cruise past untouched sandbanks, a coral reef exploration with a professional marine guide, and an overwater spa room open to the lagoon.

mauritius-grand-island-discovery.lead: Mauritius beyond the beach: Port Louis, the island’s oldest botanical garden and a private yacht, ending at One&Only Le Saint Géran.

reasons.d: The Caudan Waterfront, the Central Market and the UNESCO-listed Aapravasi Ghat, with street food from dholl puri to gateaux piments.
The SSR Botanical Garden at Pamplemousses, the oldest in the southern hemisphere, with giant water lilies, 85 varieties of palm and a spice garden.
A full-day private yacht through the northern islands with a secluded beach lunch, the sacred crater lake of Grand Bassin, and four nights at LUX* Grand Baie before Le Saint Géran.

mauritius-historic-west-marine-wildernes.lead: A villa-based journey on Mauritius’s sunset coast, with sperm whales offshore, seven-coloured earth inland and a canopy walk above rare birds.

reasons.d: A deep ocean safari to track the resident sperm whales and pods of pilot whales off the west coast.
Chamarel’s Seven Coloured Earths, and the Ebony Forest Reserve’s canopy walkway, 70 metres above the forest floor among rare endemic birds.
Maradiva is an all-villa sanctuary where each villa has its own pool, with a private gin tasting at Sublime Point and a yacht charter to Île aux Bénitiers ending in a bonfire dinner.

mauritius-indian-ocean-escape.lead: A romantic, slow Mauritius: five nights on a private peninsula at One&Only Le Saint Géran, then Grand Baie and a dolphin cruise.

reasons.d: Five nights at One&Only Le Saint Géran, on a private peninsula with more than a mile of white sand.
A private yacht day to Île aux Cerfs with a picnic prepared by the crew, a wooden cabana with muslin drapes and chilled rosé at La Pointe, and dinner at PRIME in a 16th-century chapel.
An underwater walk at three metres on the Belle Mare seabed, no swimming skills required, plus a helicopter over the island’s underwater waterfall and a dolphin catamaran cruise.

mauritius-peninsula-royal-splendor.lead: One iconic address and a whole island’s history: based at One&Only Le Saint Géran, with Port Louis, Mahébourg and the botanical garden within reach.

reasons.d: One&Only Le Saint Géran sits on a private peninsula between a turquoise lagoon and the open Indian Ocean, with water-skiing and snorkelling over the Belle Mare reef gardens.
The Aapravasi Ghat UNESCO ruins, Port Louis’s Central Bazaar, spiced-rum sundowners at Citadel Fort, and Mahébourg, the cradle of Mauritian history.
A helicopter island loop ending with breakfast on a disappearing sandbar, a barrier reef deep-sea walk, and a catamaran to Île aux Cerfs with a bonfire dinner.

mauritius-ultimate-romance-secret-lagoon.lead: Private sunset suites beneath Le Morne Brabant, with a catamaran, horses and a helicopter for the lagoons below.

reasons.d: LUX Le Morne’s sunset suites sit directly beneath Le Morne Brabant, with a trek up the UNESCO mountain to the viewpoint over the island’s underwater waterfall illusion.
A private catamaran with champagne on the net deck, sunset horse riding on untouched Riambel Beach, and a helicopter over the reefs with a champagne brunch.
A couples’ spa journey in a pavilion among orchids, snorkelling at Île aux Bénitiers, and a beachside bonfire dinner on Ilot Gabriel.

mauritius-wild-adventure.lead: The Mauritius most visitors skip: a mountain hike, forest trails and a safari park, with nine nights beneath Le Morne.

reasons.d: A private guided hike up Le Morne Brabant, 556 metres and UNESCO-listed, taking three to four hours.
Chamarel Waterfall and the Seven Coloured Earth geopark, Black River Gorges with more than 50 km of trails, and the Macchabée Trail’s view over the island’s largest wilderness.
Casela Nature Parks, with an Eco Rider safari among lions, zebra and giraffe and a walk with lions.

mauritius-wild-south-geological-wonders.lead: Mauritius’s rugged south: basalt sea cliffs, a sacred crater lake and rainforest breakfasts beside waterfalls, from a historic estate.

reasons.d: Walking the Gris Gris sea cliffs as waves crash against black basalt, and Grand Bassin, a sacred crater lake beneath 33-metre golden statues of Lord Shiva and Durga Maa.
A hot air balloon or helicopter flight over the sugar fields and dramatic sea cliffs of the Bel Ombre reserve.
Private ridge hikes in Black River Gorges, breakfast on a rock platform beside a waterfall stream, and Rochester Falls’ basalt columns, from the Heritage Le Telfair estate.

seychelles-grand-island-discovery.lead: Mahé’s Creole culture and mountain trails, then Praslin, Curieuse and Cousin: the Seychelles as a whole, not just a beach.

reasons.d: Victoria’s market, Clock Tower and Botanical Garden with its Aldabra tortoises, the ruins at Mission Lodge, dinner at Marie Antoinette, and a guided trail in Morne Seychellois National Park.
AQUA Boutique Hotel has just nine suites on a Glacis hilltop above the Indian Ocean.
Vallée de Mai and Anse Lazio on Praslin, Curieuse Island’s giant tortoises, and Cousin Island Special Nature Reserve, with a stay at Constance Lemuria.

seychelles-praslin-la-digue-collection.lead: Praslin and La Digue at a gentle pace: Vallée de Mai before the crowds, 250 giant tortoises and two days on a bicycle.

reasons.t: Vallée de Mai at opening time
reasons.d: Walked before nine in the morning, ahead of the crowds, with Anse Lazio, Anse Volbert and exclusive resort access to Anse Georgette from Constance Lemuria.
Curieuse Island’s 250 free-ranging Aldabra giant tortoises, and Cousin Island Special Nature Reserve, walked with resident wardens.
Two full days cycling an island that is practically motor-free, then crystal kayaking and a stay at Six Senses Zil Pasyon on Félicité.

seychelles-ultimate-couples-romance.lead: A couples’ Seychelles in two villa stays: Raffles on Praslin and Anantara Maia on Mahé, with a helicopter in between.

reasons.d: A private helicopter flight over the coral reefs between Mahé and Praslin.
Cycling past vanilla plantations to Anse Source d’Argent, a hidden swim at Anse Marron, and the UNESCO palm forest of Vallée de Mai, home to the Coco de Mer.

reasons.t: A sunset sail and a couples’ massage
reasons.d: A private catamaran sunset cruise with champagne and Creole appetisers, and a signature 90-minute side-by-side massage at a clifftop pavilion.
